parameters.query: WITH input_json AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p), input_data AS (SELECT p->>'worker_execution_id' AS worker_execution_id, p->>'claim_token' AS claim_token FROM input_json), candidate AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT q.phase_run_id, q.workflow_run_id, q.role_task_id, q.parent_role_task_id, q.sequence_no, q.role_id, q.task_type, q.task_payload_json, q.context_refs_json, q.expected_output_schema_ref, q.status, q.attempt, q.max_retries, q.blocker_code, q.created_at, q.claimed_at, q.completed_at FROM public.route_b_role_task_queue q WHERE q.status = 'role_task_ready' AND q.attempt < q.max_retries AND q.context_refs_json #>> '{role_context_ref,role_id}' = q.role_id ORDER BY q.phase_run_id ASC, q.sequence_no ASC, q.created_at ASC, q.role_task_id ASC FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1), claimed AS (UPDATE public.route_b_role_task_queue q SET status = 'role_task_running', attempt = q.attempt + 1, claimed_at = now() FROM candidate c WHERE q.role_task_id = c.role_task_id AND q.status = 'role_task_ready' AND q.attempt < q.max_retries RETURNING q.phase_run_id, q.workflow_run_id, q.role_task_id, q.parent_role_task_id, q.sequence_no, q.role_id, q.task_type, q.task_payload_json, q.context_refs_json, q.expected_output_schema_ref, q.status, q.attempt, q.max_retries, q.blocker_code, q.created_at, q.claimed_at, q.completed_at) SELECT true AS has_job, c.*, d.worker_execution_id, d.claim_token FROM claimed c CROSS JOIN input_data d UNION ALL SELECT false AS has_job, null::text AS phase_run_id, null::text AS workflow_run_id, null::text AS role_task_id, null::text AS parent_role_task_id, null::integer AS sequence_no, null::text AS role_id, null::text AS task_type, '{}'::jsonb AS task_payload_json, '{}'::jsonb AS context_refs_json, null::text AS expected_output_schema_ref, null::text AS status, null::integer AS attempt, null::integer AS max_retries, null::text AS blocker_code, null::timestamptz AS created_at, null::timestamptz AS claimed_at, null::timestamptz AS completed_at, d.worker_execution_id, d.claim_token FROM input_data d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claimed);

parameters.query: WITH input_json AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p), input_data AS (SELECT p, p->>'role_output_id' AS role_output_id, p->>'phase_run_id' AS phase_run_id, p->>'role_task_id' AS role_task_id, p->>'workflow_run_id' AS workflow_run_id, p->>'role_id' AS role_id, COALESCE(p->'output_json','{}'::jsonb) AS output_json, p->>'output_schema_ref' AS output_schema_ref, p->>'validation_status' AS validation_status, COALESCE(p->'validation_errors_json','[]'::jsonb) AS validation_errors_json, p->>'raw_content_hash' AS raw_content_hash, p->>'pm_l3_decision_id' AS pm_l3_decision_id, COALESCE(p->>'decision_type','no_op') AS decision_type, COALESCE(p->'decision_payload_json','{}'::jsonb) AS decision_payload_json, NULLIF(p->>'blocker_code','') AS blocker_code FROM input_json), role_output AS (INSERT INTO public.route_b_role_outputs (role_output_id, phase_run_id, role_task_id, workflow_run_id, role_id, output_json, output_schema_ref, validation_status, validation_errors_json, raw_content_hash) SELECT role_output_id, phase_run_id, role_task_id, workflow_run_id, role_id, output_json, output_schema_ref, validation_status, validation_errors_json, raw_content_hash FROM input_data ON CONFLICT (role_task_id, output_schema_ref) DO UPDATE SET output_json=EXCLUDED.output_json, validation_status=EXCLUDED.validation_status, validation_errors_json=EXCLUDED.validation_errors_json, raw_content_hash=EXCLUDED.raw_content_hash RETURNING role_output_id, validation_status, validation_errors_json, raw_content_hash), task_update AS (UPDATE public.route_b_role_task_queue q SET status=CASE WHEN d.validation_status IN ('pass','conditional_pass') THEN 'role_task_completed' WHEN d.validation_status='blocked' THEN 'blocked' ELSE 'role_task_failed' END, blocker_code=CASE WHEN d.validation_status IN ('fail','blocked') THEN COALESCE(q.blocker_code,'role_output_validation_failed') ELSE q.blocker_code END, completed_at=now() FROM input_data d WHERE q.role_task_id=d.role_task_id AND q.workflow_run_id=d.workflow_run_id AND q.role_id=d.role_id AND q.status='role_task_running' RETURNING q.role_task_id, q.status), pm_l3_decision AS (INSERT INTO public.route_b_pm_l3_decisions (pm_l3_decision_id, phase_run_id, workflow_run_id, role_task_id, decision_type, decision_payload_json, authority_boundary_json, blocker_code) SELECT pm_l3_decision_id, phase_run_id, workflow_run_id, role_task_id, decision_type, decision_payload_json, jsonb_build_object('merge_authority','PM_L2_ONLY','pm_l2_review_required',true,'n8n_merge_allowed',false,'direct_main_write_allowed',false,'force_push_allowed',false,'file_delete_allowed',false,'executor_merge_allowed',false,'ci_passed_is_not_merge_approval',true,'runtime_live_trading_allowed',false,'broker_execution_allowed',false,'server_apply_allowed',false,'production_secret_access_allowed',false,'pm_l2_approval_claimed',false,'github_execution_request_json_is_structured_handoff',true,'worker_poller_workflow_calls_github_directly',false,'worker_poller_may_merge_pr',false), blocker_code FROM input_data WHERE role_id='PM_L3_DELIVERY_VALIDATION_OWNER' AND decision_type IN ('create_next_role_task','request_github_execution_package','return_blocker','return_final_pm_l3_evidence_package','no_op') ON CONFLICT (pm_l3_decision_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING pm_l3_decision_id, decision_type, decision_payload_json, authority_boundary_json) SELECT d.p AS worker_result_json, ro.role_output_id, ro.validation_status, ro.validation_errors_json, ro.raw_content_hash, tu.status AS role_task_status, dec.pm_l3_decision_id, dec.decision_type, dec.decision_payload_json, dec.authority_boundary_json FROM input_data d LEFT JOIN role_output ro ON true LEFT JOIN task_update tu ON true LEFT JOIN pm_l3_decision dec ON true;
